import pytest

@pytest.fixture(scope="module", autouse=True)
def my_fixture():
    global call_count
    call_count = getattr(pytest, '_test_call_count', 0) + 1
    pytest._test_call_count = call_count
    yield

def test_fixture_called_once():
    # In 9.0.3, this fixture runs once even with --doctest-modules
    # In 9.1.0, it runs twice (once per collection pass)
    assert pytest._test_call_count == 1, f"Expected 1, got {pytest._test_call_count}"
